safety.comment: Controller does not answer CMD_MULT_SERVO_POS_READ -> NO position feedback, motion is open loop and stalls cannot be detected by reading position. Therefore limits must stay conservative, every servo must be unloaded (torque off) shortly after each move (hold_ms) and on any idle period (idle_unload_ms), and a hard continuous-torque cap (max_continuous_torque_ms) forces an unload no matter what.
safety.gripper_note: NEVER command servo 1 (GRIP) below 1500 under any circumstance -- this is documentation only. The real enforcement is the hardcoded ELECTRICAL_LIMITS[1] floor in robohand/config.py, which cannot be widened by editing this file. robohand.config raises at import time if this value and the hardcoded one disagree.

vision.roi_comment: Pixel [x, y, w, h] = left half of the 1280x720 frame, full height (values >1 are absolute pixels; values in (0,1] are fractions). Re-measured 2026-07-31: the scene now contains a small always-on LCD display on the TV stand (x~800-1120, y~240-390) whose refresh flicker alone contributed a per-tile no-motion p95 of 10,368+3,584+1,283 changed px, a dark TV (x>=750) that reflects room motion, and a lamp top-centre that triggers episodic auto-exposure hunting -- full-frame no-motion p95 measured 14,477-16,187 changed px (camera-check FAIL, headroom 0.2x). This ROI keeps the entire arm, its full vertical extent, the gripper's roll-sweep cone (staged pose, ELBOW tipped), and the table workspace, and excludes the LCD/TV/right side. Measured with `camera-check --roi 0 0 640 720` (15x0.8s): no-motion p95=415, max=423 -> PASS, headroom 7.2x at the old 3000 threshold; the variant [0,110,640,610] additionally excluding the lamp strip measured p95=373-387 over 15- and 30-frame windows but clips the gripper's jaws-up roll orientations, so the full-height crop is shipped. The previous full-frame ROI comment's numbers (noise 454/577, SHOULDER_PAN 78,116, GRIP 25,746) predate the LCD appearing in-scene. If the camera, arm mount, or the ROOM CONTENTS (lamp/TV/LCD) change again, re-measure with `robohand camera-check`. The obsolete full-frame ROI was [0,0,1.0,1.0]; the obsolete narrow dark-corner-only ROI was [0,300,520,420].
vision.min_changed_pixels_comment: Site-specific for THIS arm+camera with the 2026-07-31 left-half ROI [0,0,640,720], re-derived by the same procedure as the previous full-frame value (geometric mean of worst no-motion noise and weakest measured real signal, camera-check protocol, 20-warmup/8-flush capture): worst observed in-ROI no-motion p95 = 415 changed px (max 423); weakest measured real motion = a 30-raw-unit WRIST_ROLL step (the calibrator's probe increment) with the gripper staged in frame = 4,148 changed px (4,165 via the full-height crop; the same step with the gripper OUT of frame scored only 2,161 -- stage the gripper into frame before calibrating wrist joints). sqrt(415*4148) ~= 1,312 -> 1300. Checks: 1300 >= 1.5x415=623 gate requirement (2.1x the requirement; headroom 1300/415 = 3.1x); measured separation of the real move vs noise = 4,148/415 = 10.0x (>= the 3.0 health_separation floor); signal/threshold = 3.2x. The previous value 3000 was derived for the full-frame ROI (noise 577 vs GRIP 25,746) and left the WRIST_ROLL calibration step only 1.38x above threshold under this crop -- too tight to trust 'no motion' inference. diff_threshold=25 unchanged. robohand/config.py's generic fallback stays at 150 for OTHER unmeasured deployments -- only this live config carries the measured value.
vision.health_comment: Camera-health gate (robohand/camera_health.py). health_interval_s (0.8) and health_frames (15) validated in a prior round (spans more of any auto-exposure hunting cycle; surfaces a higher, more honest noise floor). Re-measured 2026-07-31 for the left-half ROI + 1300 threshold: health_margin (1.5): required = 1.5 * 415 ~= 623, comfortably below the 1300 threshold (2.1x the requirement) -- the config PASSES in the current scene while still rejecting a regression (any in-ROI noise floor above 1300/1.5 ~= 867 makes required exceed 1300 -> FAIL; the flickering LCD alone measured >15,000 full-frame, so un-cropping instantly fails again, as it should). health_separation (3.0): floor = 3 * 415 ~= 1245; the weakest measured real move (WRIST_ROLL 30-unit step, gripper staged in frame, 4,148 changed px) clears it by ~3.3x and clears the live-scene noise by 10x. See docs/verification-camera.md.

gripper.comment: Hard backstops for the incremental grip ladder -- deliberately identical to GRIP's configured min/max above, never crossed regardless of what the vision guard reports. Lower raw = MORE OPEN for this servo, so the ladder closes by increasing toward grip_max_safe and opens by decreasing toward grip_min_safe. grip_min_safe (1600) still stays 100 clear of the true 1500 mechanical/electrical floor.
